summary: Iteration 270: Per-Room-Type Rate Override feature fully tested. All 20 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified room type selector, scope badge, clear button, drawer scope, and all existing features (FLOWCAST, winloss, insights) working correctly.

issues: Console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' - React hydration warning due to dynamic content in select options. Minor issue, does not affect functionality.

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/rates/grid/{property_id}?room_type_id=<id> correctly returns scoped overrides with room_type_id field in response
POST /api/rates/grid/override saves with room_type_id - Standard (£200), Deluxe (£350), property-wide (£90) stored separately without collision
POST /api/rates/grid/submit-to-pms writes to db.rate_overrides scoped per room_type and updates rate_override_history with room_type_id
POST /api/rates/grid/release/{prop}/{date}?room_type_id=<id> only deletes scoped override, leaves other room types intact
Booking creation (POST /api/booking/reserve) uses room-type-specific owner-override first, falls back to property-wide override
Existing endpoints (explain, winloss, insights) still work with lookback_days param
Frontend MyRatesPanel: data-testid='rates-room-type-select' loads room types correctly
Frontend: data-testid='scope-badge' shows 'Otel geneli (varsayılan)' for property-wide, room type name when selected
Frontend: Rate drawer shows scope badge with selected room type
Auth required for all rates endpoints (401/403 returned correctly)
seed_data_creation: Created test overrides for Standard (£200), Deluxe (£350), and property-wide (£90) on test dates
